question: A total profit of ₹25,000 is to be distributed amongst P, Q and R such that P : Q = 2 : 1 and Q : R = 11 : 7. The share (in ₹) of R in the profit is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

P : Q = 2 : 1 and Q : R = 11 : 7

Equalize Q ⇒ P : Q = 22 : 11

So P : Q : R = 22 : 11 : 7

Total parts = 40 ⇒ R = (7/40) × 25000

**∴ Answer = 4375**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P : Q = 2 : 1

Q : R = 11 : 7

Total profit = 25000

**Formula used:**

Share = (Ratio part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Make Q same in both ratios

⇒ Multiply first ratio by 11 ⇒ P : Q = 22 : 11

⇒ Combine ⇒ P : Q : R = 22 : 11 : 7

⇒ Total parts = 22 + 11 + 7 = 40

⇒ Share of R = (7/40) × 25000

⇒ = 4375

**∴ The correct answer is 4375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

Make common term equal before combining ratios.

Distribution Rule

Share ∝ ratio parts.

Quick Trick

Multiply ratios to match common terms.
